title: 第十四章 姐姐，我很喜欢你哦~
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

人族是内敛的，魔族是放肆、奔放的，他们是随心所欲的性格。

这也使得魔族人要比人族更畏惧强者。

人族的仁爱是不会出现在魔族那边的。

同样的，人魔两族也有着巨大的不同。

瞧见白玥的眼神，枫溪压低声音说着，“姐姐，你喜欢我的尾巴么？”

“要是喜欢的话，我可以给你摸摸哦~”

要是其他人，胆敢用冒犯的眼神来看着自己的尾巴，枫溪早就发飙了。

她的原则会对白玥所更改。

正如同她所说的那般，她们是姐妹，是有着相同血脉的亲姊妹。

虽然她们不是一个母亲所生，但她们都是逆天魔龙族的公主。

“这……”

白玥迟疑地看着枫溪，她的瞳孔微微收缩。

那双眼中是难以置信的情绪。

“真的可以吗？”

白玥惊愕地看着她。

“当然可以~”

“你是我的姐姐，摸一下是很正常的~”

枫溪的唇微微上扬着，勾起少许的弧度，那双眼眸充斥着笑意，“我的原则可以为你更改，你是不一样的。”

“那些庸俗、愚蠢的人，只配得到鲜血的洗礼。”

要是在平时，枫溪是不会露出自己的龙尾巴。

自认为高贵，内心极为高傲的逆天魔龙族是不会低下自己高傲的头颅，甚至是放低身段。

枫溪能对白玥例外，那是因为她们是血脉相连的亲人。

白玥的眼眸再次被眼泪所浸满，那种复杂的感觉再次充斥于心中。

她能从枫溪的话语之中意识到对方对自己的在意。

那不是随口一说，而是认真地说着。

“那我摸了……”

白玥一边说着，一边走到枫溪的旁边。

在枫溪那灿烂的笑容下，主动伸出手来。

她还没反应过来，那透着一层淡淡紫光有着冰冷黑色鳞片的龙尾巴就到了她的手上。

冰冷的鳞片并未被温热的温泉水所暖热，仍然是凉凉的。

摸在手心上，那股寒冷感席卷而来。

说实话，白玥能清晰地感受到逆天魔龙族的威压，那种血脉相连的感觉……就像是在呼唤着她的意志，让她沉浸于这份突然出现的亲情之中。

这种感觉真的好奇怪。

这是白玥的第一想法。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The human race is restrained, while the demon race is unbridled and unrestrained. They have a character that follows their whims.

This also makes the demons fear the strong more than the humans.

The benevolence of the human race will not appear on the side of the demon race.

Similarly, there are huge differences between the human and demon races.

Seeing Bai Yue's eyes, Fengxi lowered her voice and said, "Sister, do you like my tail?"

"If you like it, I can touch it for you~"

If other people dared to look at his tail with offensive eyes, Fengxi would have gone crazy.

Her principles will be changed by Bai Yue.

Just as she said, they are sisters, sisters with the same blood.

Although they were not born to the same mother, they were both princesses of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan.

"This..."

Bai Yue looked at Fengxi hesitantly, her pupils shrinking slightly.

There was incredible emotion in those eyes.

"Is it really okay?"

Bai Yue looked at her in shock.

"Of course~"

"You are my sister, it's normal to touch her~"

Feng Xi's lips were raised slightly, with a slight arc, and her eyes were full of smiles, "My principles can be changed for you, you are different."

"Those vulgar and stupid people only deserve the baptism of blood."

Normally, Fengxi would not show his dragon tail.

The Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, who consider themselves noble and extremely arrogant in their hearts, will not lower their arrogant heads or even their stature.

Fengxi can make an exception for Bai Yue because they are relatives connected by blood.

Bai Yue's eyes were once again filled with tears, and that complicated feeling filled her heart again.

She could realize from Fengxi's words that the other party cared about her.

That was not said casually, but said seriously.

"Then I touched it..."

Bai Yue said as she walked to Fengxi's side.

Under Fengxi's bright smile, he took the initiative to reach out his hand.

Before she could react, the dragon tail with a layer of pale purple light and cold black scales was in her hand.

The cold scales were not warmed by the warm hot spring water and were still cool.

Touching it on the palm of your hand, a cold feeling swept over you.

To be honest, Bai Yue could clearly feel the pressure of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, and that feeling of blood connection... was like calling her will, allowing her to immerse herself in this sudden family affection.

This feeling is really strange.

This was Bai Yue's first thought.
